summary.text: Mike Dwyer is a Republican state senator from North Dakota who has represented District 47 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Dwyer assumed office in the North Dakota State Senate on December 1, 2018, succeeding Ralph Kilzer.

Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Senate Judiciary Committee and a member of the Senate Transportation Committee in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions, and on the Appropriations Government Operations Division for 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
